text: Representatives from the Poverty Reduction Strategy Office, City of Toronto, and the Toronto Aboriginal Support Services Council will present a preliminary mid-term status update for the 2019-2022 Poverty Reduction Strategy Action Plan and an update on the critical path for development of the Tkaronto Prosperity Plan and the Toronto Aboriginal Research Project 2. Feedback from Committee members will be incorporated into the Poverty Reduction Strategy's staff report to be considered by the Executive Committee at its June 1, 2021, meeting.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
